description: Instead of the time the business proposed, ask for another: start_time must be one of the free times check_availability lists (the end follows the service's length). The business confirms it or proposes again. On a confirmed booking it asks the business to move it (the end keeps the booking's length), and the booking stays as agreed until the business says yes. After a few rounds, or past the changes a booking may have, a person there answers it instead (passed_on).

access_token.description: Capability secret returned when the item was created without an account.

idempotency_key.description: Same key + same request = same answer. Required for agents.

key.description: The person's key (sdkey1_…), if that is all you have: it is exchanged once for a pass, which comes back in identity.passes — keep the pass and send it next time instead. Never stored.

pass.description: The person's passes (sdpass1_…), space-separated, at most 8: presented to the network that issued each, so the business recognises the customer. Or send them in the Sdi-Pass header. Never stored.

start_time.description: The start your person would like instead: one of the free times check_availability lists. The end follows the service's length.

name: suggest_time
title: Ask for another time
